name: universal-poison-armor
description: Multi-layer security firewall and AI poison defense for agents, RAG pipelines, and LLMs

tools.name: sanitize_document
tools.description: Sanitizes untrusted text against Markdown XSS tracking pixels, zero-width Unicode steganography, prompt injections, and adversarial suffixes (GCG attacks). Use on single files, raw user inputs, or individual RAG chunks before LLM ingestion.

document_text.description: The raw untrusted text content to sanitize.

tools.name: scan_dataset_for_anomalies
tools.description: Scans document collections, training examples, or RAG chunks for semantic outlier clusters and backdoor poisoned data using dense embeddings and Isolation Forests. Use on batches of documents to isolate compromised samples.

documents.description: A list of text documents or context chunks to analyze for distribution anomalies.

tools.name: verify_article_consensus
tools.description: Audits domain provenance (.gov/.edu) and detects coordinated near-duplicate Sybil flooding / Consensus Poisoning campaigns across search results using pairwise semantic similarity. Use when multiple web articles or search results are retrieved.

title.description: Headline or title of the article.

articles.description: A list of article objects to verify for authentic consensus vs coordinated Sybil flooding.

resources.name: Security Audit Log
resources.description: Exposes the persistent local security_audit.json audit trail as an MCP resource.

resources.name: Defense Policy & Thresholds
resources.description: Active AI poison defense parameters, Shannon entropy threshold, and detection rules.

prompts.name: sanitize_untrusted_input
prompts.description: Security-focused prompt template guiding the agent to sanitize and inspect untrusted input.

arguments.name: untrusted_content
arguments.description: The raw untrusted text content to sanitize.

prompts.name: audit_dataset_security
prompts.description: Security audit prompt template for scanning document collections for poisoned samples.

arguments.name: dataset_summary
arguments.description: Summary or overview of the dataset to audit.
